protocol.training: action-rank sampled stored DCT3 units; no retrieval key input; arm6 flow loss; frozen VLM
protocol.confidence: memory episode holdout only; features from draft-vs-π0.5 distance, score margin, entropy, arm norm ratio
protocol.closed_loop_seed: same EX1/lib-closed rule: base 7; task initial-state index; replan 5; max 520

schedule.rule: clip(c*sqrt(predicted_arm6_error), .05, .6); if predicted error > threshold use π0.5

offline.metric: arm6 MSE = sum over 10x6 squared normalized error / 70; active7 adds π0.5 gripper
